Draft admission orders (ready to sign):

1) Admit to medical floor; diagnosis: community-acquired pneumonia (right lower lobe) with sepsis. 
2) Antibiotics: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV every 24 hours IV; Azithromycin 500 mg IV once now, then 500 mg IV every 24 hours (adjust to PO 500 mg daily or 250 mg daily per local protocol when appropriate). 
3) PRN antipyretic: Acetaminophen 650 mg PO/PR every 4–6 hours PRN for fever or discomfort, maximum 4 g in 24 hours. 
4) Labs/diagnostics: CBC with differential, BMP, LFTs, lactate (STAT); obtain blood cultures x2 sets prior to antibiotic administration if not already obtained. 
5) Nursing: Oxygen via nasal cannula to maintain SpO2 ≥92% (currently 3 L NC); continuous pulse oximetry while on supplemental O2; vital signs q4h and PRN; notify MD for SBP <90 mmHg, HR >120, RR >24, or O2 saturation <92%.
